header.title: Latex Suite 1.13.1 random keystroke fixtures
header.howProduced: Random notes, carets and keystrokes, every one recorded from the plugin itself: the same headless harness as latex-suite-cases.json, driven by a fixed-seed generator (seeds 11 and 23) over the short notes of latex-suite-context.json, with seven carets in ten placed inside math. Each case is one to four steps; a step is a single key (letters, digits, brackets, `$`, `\`, Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Shift+Enter, Backspace) or a known trigger typed key by key. Only cases where Latex Suite handled at least one key are kept. The one case family left out is the caret right before the `$$` of an inline `$$x$$` followed by `/`, where the plugin throws (see LatexSuiteTests).
header.fields: As in latex-suite-cases.json; `name`, `notes` and `refs` carry nothing here.
